# Third-party notices

## ChordBook Editor

The CodeMirror editor setup in `src/repertoire/chordBookEditor.ts` is adapted from [ChordBook Editor](https://github.com/chordbook/editor), Copyright (c) 2024-present ChordBook project contributors. The repository README and included `chordbook/LICENSE` specify GNU GPL version 3. Its `package.json` says ISC; this integration follows the repository README and license file.

## ChordPro CodeMirror language

`@chordbook/codemirror-lang-chordpro` provides ChordPro parsing, syntax highlighting, and directive completions. It is Copyright (c) 2021 BetterMusic and contributors; modifications are Copyright (c) 2024 Brandon Keepers and contributors. Its MIT license is in `chordbook/codemirror-lang-chordpro-LICENSE`.

## CodeMirror

The editor uses CodeMirror 6 packages from the `@codemirror` and `@lezer` projects. Their MIT notices are copied into `codemirror-licenses/`.

## SpessaSynth

The lazy browser synth bundle and AudioWorklet processor are from [spessasynth_lib](https://github.com/spessasus/spessasynth_lib) 4.3.14 and [spessasynth_core](https://github.com/spessasus/spessasynth_lib) 4.3.22. They are distributed under Apache-2.0. The bundle includes `stb-vorbis` 0.0.6 under Apache-2.0. License texts are in `spessasynth/`.

## MuseScore General SoundFont

`public/audio/harmony/MuseScore_General.sf3` is shared under MIT. Its required acknowledgements and source credits are included in `public/audio/harmony/MuseScore_General_License.md`.
